Game settings ⚙

🎮 Controls
Select any key binding, then press the key you want to use. Your changes save automatically. Shift Lock (mouse look) is included here.
🏆 World Cup
Pauses at the halfway point. Select “Start second half” to continue.Every World Cup match displays a 1–90 minute match clock. The full 90-minute game is compressed to fit the real match length you choose above. This setting only affects World Cup matches.
🧤 Gameplay
Easy keeps the current behavior. Medium and Hard make CPU players adapt after lost chances, use better passing/pressing plans, and improve goalkeeper reactions.Turn random maps off to keep your selected map.Hides celebration controls and skips celebration animations.
🎵 Music
The chosen song loops until you change it. Music stops when a match starts and comes back when it ends. The pause screen has its own calm aquarium ambience. All songs are original instrumentals with no lyrics.
🎯 Penalty Shootout
Shrink or hide the control hints. You can also switch it from the pause screen.
🖥 Graphics & Performance
FPS and network ping are measured separately. Ping appears when connected to a multiplayer server.

🎁 Give Rewards to a Lobby PlayerEnter a whole number, then press the matching button or Enter. Rewards go directly to the selected player's account.

🎮 CONTROLS

Street Soccer 3D
3v3 on a caged court under the lamps. Run with WASD, Shift to sprint, Space to shoot, Q to pass, F for a through ball, E to slide tackle. Ctrl toggles shift lock; move mouse to look (no UI click needed), 1 and 2 switch player, hold right-click to look around. Player 2 moves with I/J/K/L and adjusts the camera with 4/5 and 6/7. Esc pauses.
